messages:
Anya R: Quick sync on GPU capacity follow-ups. Need to confirm owners + short checkpoints so we don't drift. Posting minimal update + ask for fast acks.

Samir: Ack. Post it.

Anya R: Actions we had: 1) reservation min headroom + burstable tiers (owner @Samir) 2) autoscaler hysteresis & cooldown (owner @Priya K) 3) scheduler soft-evict window + priority decay (owner @Jules) 4) emergency manual quota toggle + runbook step (owner @Anya R) 5) replay harness + regression tests (owner infra-sig). Please confirm feasibility and earliest ETA (days).

Priya K: Feasible. ETA: next sprint start for design work, prototype 5 business days. Will add simulation results.

Jules: Feasible. Can run a 2-day canary after I push flags: --evict-soft-window=20s --priority-decay=30s. ETA 7 days for rollout plan.

Samir: I can produce the reservation PR. Proposal: guaranteed_headroom_pct=12, burstable_cap_pct=25 based on recent incident percentiles. ETA 10 days to get reviews and rollout plan.

Anya R: Ill create the manual quota toggle and update the runbook today. ETA 3 days.

incident-bot: Trace export available: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/traces/mar11-v2.tar.gz

Samir: Thanks bot. Will consume traces to calculate 95/99 tail peaks.

Priya K: One ask: can we pause aggressive evictions for a rolling 24h window during the rollout to reduce churn? If so, Ill gate that behind a feature flag.

Anya R: Yes pause approved for rollout window. Add it as a checklist item in your ticket.

Jules: Adding derived metric gpu_headroom_pct and alert if <12% for >2m to RW ticket.

Anya R: Please :white_check_mark: when tickets created so I can update the postmortem followups doc. Ill run a checkpoint in 48h.

Samir: :white_check_mark: (RW-2075 created)

Priya K: :white_check_mark: (RW-2076 created)

Jules: :white_check_mark: (RW-2077 created)

Anya R: Thanks, will add infra-sig for RW-2078 (harness) and close loop in 48h.
